alexander-reaches-india: At the Battle of the Hydaspes, in today's Pakistan, Alexander defeats King Porus. His exhausted army then refuses to go further east.
mansa-musas-pilgrimage-to-mecca: The king of Mali travels with so much gold that he depresses its price in Cairo for years.
act-of-abjuration: The northern provinces formally renounce Philip II of Spain, an early declaration of independence.
newtons-plague-years: Sent home from Cambridge by the plague, Newton works out calculus, his theory of colour and the first ideas of gravity.
brazil-abolishes-slavery: The Golden Law makes Brazil the last country in the Americas to abolish slavery.
afsluitdijk-completed: A 32 km dam closes off the Zuiderzee, turning it into the freshwater IJsselmeer.
lucy-discovered: A 3.2-million-year-old skeleton of Australopithecus afarensis, found at Hadar.
